_provenance: AUTHORED BY THE LEAD, not by a subagent. These 12 rows entered the union AFTER the three disposition agents were launched (the cc-custom enriched extraction reassigned their families), so no agent was assigned them. A dedicated gap-fill agent was dispatched and did not deliver within a full goal round, so the lead authored them directly from the union data, following agent C's rubric and precedents. They therefore carry less independent review than the other rows -- the distinction is recorded rather than hidden.
_superseded: This file originally held 25 rows. The interface+inspect agent later re-issued its own file against the current 147-row union, covering 13 of them (cost, heapdump, insights, stats, version, brief, color, config, keybindings, output-style, stickers, terminal-setup, tui). Those 13 were REMOVED from here so that the independently-reviewed agent verdicts win; the two files disagreed on 7 of the 13, and an agent that verified its claims against I-harness source (including reading the vim-mode capability gate, and anchoring 不做 in README.md:262 / CAPABILITIES.md:128-129) is better evidence than a lead-authored row.
_consistency_notes: The prompt-command category is split deliberately. Agent C marked security-review / pr-comments / init-verifiers `路線差異` because cc-custom is itself MIGRATING that content to its plugin marketplace, making them transitional. code-review / commit / commit-push-pr are NOT migrated -- they remain first-class prompt commands -- so they are `rewrite` (an actionable gap) rather than `路線差異`.
`branch` is cc-custom's spelling of a capability I-harness ships as /fork. It carries NO I-harness cell, so rule 1 forbids 已存在; `路線差異` records that the absence is naming, not capability.
